content.value_statement: Independent plan tasks are hard to execute consistently with clean review handoffs. This skill coordinates implementer, spec reviewer, and code reviewer subagents in one session.
actual_capabilities: Defines when to use same-session subagent execution for independent plan tasks.
Provides a per-task workflow for implementer, spec compliance reviewer, and code quality reviewer subagents.
Includes reusable prompt templates for implementation, spec review, and code review dispatch.
Encourages explicit task extraction, context handoff, testing, self-review, and review loops.
Documents red flags that prevent skipping reviews or moving forward with unresolved issues.
limitations: Requires an existing implementation plan with clearly separated tasks.
Works best when tasks are mostly independent and can be reviewed one at a time.
Does not execute code or create subagents by itself; it provides workflow instructions.
References companion workflow skills that may not be installed in every environment.

use_cases.title: Execute a Feature Plan
use_cases.description: Break a prepared feature plan into task handoffs, then run implementation and review cycles for each task.

use_cases.title: Control Review Quality
use_cases.description: Use separate reviewers to verify spec compliance before checking maintainability, tests, and implementation quality.

use_cases.title: Manage AI Coding Sessions
use_cases.description: Keep a long coding session organized by giving each subagent complete task context and clear acceptance gates.

prompt_templates.title: Run One Independent Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single task from an existing plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-driven-development for Task 1 in my plan. Extract the full task text, dispatch an implementer, and run both review stages.

prompt_templates.title: Execute a Small Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for several mostly independent tasks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-driven-development to execute this three-task implementation plan in the current session. Keep each task separate and wait for both reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Spec Compliance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request where overbuilding or missed requirements are high risk.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow and make spec compliance strict. Do not move to code quality review until the implementation matches the task exactly.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Full Branch Finish
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for end-to-end plan execution with final review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run subagent-driven-development across all independent tasks, resolve reviewer findings, then dispatch a final review for the whole implementation.

output_examples.input: Execute the authentication cleanup plan using separate subagents for each task.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates a task list, dispatches an implementer for the first task, sends the result to spec review, then requests code quality review.

output_examples.input: Review whether the completed task matches the plan before continuing.
output_examples.output: The spec reviewer compares the task requirements with the actual implementation and reports either approval or specific missing and extra work.

output_examples.input: Continue after the reviewer found a missing requirement.
output_examples.output: The implementer fixes the gap, the same review gate runs again, and the task remains open until approval.

best_practices: Paste complete task text and relevant context into each subagent prompt.
Run spec compliance review before code quality review for every task.
Keep review findings open until the implementer fixes them and the reviewer approves.
anti_patterns: Do not dispatch multiple implementation subagents that edit the same files at once.
Do not let an implementer self-review replace independent review stages.
Do not ask subagents to infer missing plan details from incomplete context.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It defines a same-session workflow for executing independent plan tasks with implementer and reviewer subagents.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation and prompt templates. It does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: When should I avoid using it?
faq.answer: Avoid it when tasks are tightly coupled, the plan is unclear, or independent subagent handoffs would create conflicts.

faq.question: Why are there two review stages?
faq.answer: Spec review checks whether the right work was done. Code quality review checks whether the work is maintainable and tested.

faq.question: Can it replace human judgment?
faq.answer: No. A human should still define the plan, answer subagent questions, and decide whether final changes are acceptable.
